g.text: Verification Workflow: HTTP Missing Security Headers
Description: Confirm which security response headers are absent. The nuclei template fires one
matcher per missing header, so verify every header it named, not just HSTS.
│ Pull the full response header set
│ Notes: Compare against the matcher names in the nuclei output. Check for:
│ X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies. Each matcher whose header is absent = confirmed. Use GET, not
│ and WAFs only add headers to GET responses. If the root redirects, also check the final landing
│ authenticated page if one is in scope.
│ Spot-check a second path and an API response
│ Notes: Headers set by application code (not the web server or load balancer) often disappear on
│ endpoints. A header missing only on some responses is still worth reporting, with the affected
│ HSTS specifically with the 'HSTS Missing From HTTPS Server' workflow.
